title: monki-focus time token claims (v1)
description: Claims of a PASETO v4.public time token, signed with the unlock-signing key and bound by its implicit assertion to the request's nonce and boot id. The signed message must also be the canonical serialisation of these claims (docs/protocol/unlock-tokens.md §4.0). Semantic rules beyond this schema: iss, dev, nonce and boot equal the pinned issuer, this device and the request.

dev.description: Device uuid the token is bound to (also bound by the implicit assertion).

nonce.description: The 16-byte random nonce the client sent, unpadded base64url.

boot.description: The boot id the client sent.

srv.description: Server time when the answer was signed.

revoked.description: Revoked, not yet expired unlock tokens of this device.

complete.description: False when more revocations exist than fit; the client then revalidates every received or active unlock.

issuer.description: Instance origin. Release: lowercase https://host, no port, path or trailing slash. Development only: http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 with an optional non-default port. Never contains "|".

rfc3339Utc.description: UTC instant as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (whole seconds, no offset, year >= 1970). Verifiers also check that the day exists in its month (no 2026-02-30), which a pattern cannot express.
